chapter: Arranging career and the JPJ Quartet
title: Stock arrangements for Benny Goodman's sextet
summary: Budd wrote stock arrangements of Goodman sextet tunes such as 'Soft Winds', a solo for Charlie Christian.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: As you go down telling me all these different people you worked with, if you could think of -- if you can think of any particular tune you wrote for so and so, pick any particular tune, just mention it.
Okay. And I wrote for Benny Goodman. I wrote for Benny Goodman's publishing company, which is at 1619 Broadway.

Well, it's Harmon and he has another company, and I wrote all of what you call the Gigin gigin series, made stock arrangements. I used to make stock arrangements for Benny Goodman's company. When he had the group with Teddy Wilson and Charlie Christian, and some of the Fletcher Henderson things I wrote those and made stock arrangements out of them. They called it gigin series like with eight pieces. And --
Was there any one tune in that series?
Well, yeah, one of the things that I did especially was -- what was this thing called? (Singing of notes.)
'Soft Winds.' That's a great solo for Johnny Charlie Christian. Well, I did all of those things practically -- well, I won't say practically all of them, I must have made at least 15 or 20--
